description: Add one reachable upper-floor Bedroom above the canonical Living Room

replacements.old:
(EAST TO KITCHEN)
      (WEST TO STRANGE-PASSAGE IF MAGIC-FLAG ELSE "The door is nailed shut.")
replacements.new:
(EAST TO KITCHEN)
      (UP TO BEDROOM)
      (WEST TO STRANGE-PASSAGE IF MAGIC-FLAG ELSE "The door is nailed shut.")

(GLOBAL STAIRS)
      (PSEUDO "NAILS" NAILS-PSEUDO "NAIL" NAILS-PSEUDO)>

<ROOM BEDROOM
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Bedroom")
      (DOWN TO LIVING-ROOM)
      (ACTION HOUSE-REST-BEDROOM-FCN)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT ONBIT SACREDBIT)
      (GLOBAL STAIRS WHITE-HOUSE)>
